snippet.title: A Rat's Quest - The Way back Home | Season 1 // Release Trailer
snippet.description:
#ARatsQuest #ActionAdventure #outnow 
The wait is over for the most ambitious indie title to emerge from the Mexican development scene.  A Rat’s Quest - The Way Back Home | Season 1 is available now for PC!

Mat’s journey begins in the relative safety of an old wine cellar, but his love for Nat takes him into the heart of a giant’s household. This season follows Mat’s rise as a Scavenger, the discovery of a dark conspiracy within the rat commune, and a dramatic betrayal that leaves him stranded far from home and desperate to return. It is a story of small heroes facing massive consequences.

A Rat’s Quest - The Way Back Home | Season 1 is available now on:
STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124420/A_Rats_Quest__The_Way_Back_Home/
EPIC - https://store.epicgames.com/p/a-rats-quest-f610d5
GOG - https://www.gog.com/game/a_rats_quest_the_way_back_home_season_1
